goal_fields.name: request_id
goal_fields.description: Root request identity; a worker claim never authorizes another request.

goal_fields.name: goal_id
goal_fields.description: Unique persisted task intent within the root run.

goal_fields.name: run_id
goal_fields.description: Canonical root run identity; no independent device run is created.

goal_fields.name: attempt_id
goal_fields.description: Current DNA measurement attempt identity.

goal_fields.name: context_id
goal_fields.description: Active device context identity.

goal_fields.name: operation
goal_fields.description: Bounded semantic vessel handling; no path or joint program.

goal_fields.name: mode
goal_fields.description: B0 accepts only explicit synthetic tasks.

goal_fields.name: sample_id
goal_fields.description: Stable original DNA sample identity.

goal_fields.name: vessel_id
goal_fields.description: Selected original or dilution vessel identity.

goal_fields.name: executing_agent_id
goal_fields.description: Assigned executor, separate from the responsible person and requesting principal.

goal_fields.name: source_manifest_sha256
goal_fields.description: Exact root source-manifest digest; not a worker assertion of qualification.

goal_fields.name: task_contract_sha256
goal_fields.description: Digest of this exact leading task contract.

goal_fields.name: content_revision
goal_fields.description: Root vessel-content revision; quantity and volume are not carried or booked here.

goal_fields.name: source_kind
goal_fields.description: Physical source role; an agent is never encoded as a fictitious rack.

goal_fields.name: source_rack_id
goal_fields.description: Required for rack source, otherwise the empty string.

goal_fields.name: source_place_id
goal_fields.description: Required local place for rack source, otherwise the empty string.

goal_fields.name: source_agent_id
goal_fields.description: Required custodian for agent source, otherwise the empty string.

goal_fields.name: target_kind
goal_fields.description: Claimed transfer destination role, pending independent root acceptance.

goal_fields.name: target_rack_id
goal_fields.description: Required for rack target, otherwise the empty string.

goal_fields.name: target_place_id
goal_fields.description: Required local place for rack target, otherwise the empty string.

goal_fields.name: target_agent_id
goal_fields.description: Required custodian for agent target, otherwise the empty string.

claim_fields.name: claim_id
claim_fields.description: Unique worker report identity; this is not an observation or a consumption booking.

claim_fields.name: worker_boot_id
claim_fields.description: Worker process epoch; root must not replay uncertain work after restart.

claim_fields.name: outcome
claim_fields.description: Worker assertion only; root observation and scientific acceptance remain separate.

claim_fields.name: evidence
claim_fields.description: Unpromoted worker claim, never person confirmation, scan or sensor evidence.

claim_fields.name: motion_executed
claim_fields.description: Always false in B0; semantic dispatch performs no robot trajectory.

feedback_fields.name: phase
feedback_fields.description: Reserved synthetic feedback phase, without progress or motion claim.

limitations: B0 defines and locally decodes generated ROS action fields; no ROS installation, DDS communication or action server is executed
MockTaskWorker reports a synthetic claim only and never receives a journal, workflow, inventory or ledger handle
Only rack-to-assigned-agent and assigned-agent-to-rack transfers are modeled; no rack-to-rack path or agent handover
Worker claims do not confirm physical custody, alter volume, accept measurements, or release root reservations
Source pins and worker identities are bindings, not authentication, hardware qualification or a motion proof
